messages:
maria: mockup uploaded — wondering about inline errors vs top summary for the settings form. mobile space is tight. thoughts?

ton y: prefer concise inline errors for fields users interact with. summary only for batch submit failures. :thumbsup:

jia: agree. inline for immediate validation, but we need a11y: ensure errors announced via `role="alert"` and use `aria-describedby` for field-level hints.

oliver: question on required markers — asterisk alone or explicit 'Required' text? asterisk is compact but confusing for some users.

maria: yeah. asterisk + tooltip could work on desktop but not on mobile. maybe show explicit 'Required' for dense forms or critical fields.

ton y: proposal: default to asterisk for space savings, but always include visible text for the first required field in each section. screen readers still get the explicit `aria-required`.

jia: quick note on error placement: inline message should live below input and include a short action (e.g., 'Enter a valid email'). long lists should keep a summary at the top with links into the fields.

maria: microcopy question for delete modal — typed confirm vs checkbox? which feels right for org-level vs item-level deletes?

oliver: typed confirm is stronger deterrent but adds friction. checkbox is easier but can be missed. typed confirm is good for irreversible org-level actions.

maria: can we do hybrid? typed confirm for org-level (projects, orgs), checkbox for row-level (single policy). also include the exact consequence copy.

jia: agree on hybrid. accessibility bits: trap focus, set `aria-modal="true"`, initial focus on heading, and provide `aria-describedby` that reads the consequence. screen readers should announce the typed-confirm instruction before the input.

design-bot: FYI — linked pattern doc: https://go/internal/design/forms#destructive-actions (contains checklist and past decisions)

maria: great, i'll prototype two variants in Figma and attach an a11y checklist. tagging @oliver for copy polish.

oliver: happy to help. quick draft copy ideas:
- Option A (typed): "Delete project — This action permanently removes all project data. Type the project name to confirm."
- Option B (checkbox): "Delete — This will permanently delete this item. Check 'I understand' to proceed."

ton y: prefer Option A for org-level, Option B for per-item. :+1:

maria: cool — i'll iterate and post prototypes for quick review. thanks everyone!
